summary: Iteration 4 backend-only verification of rental $150 security deposit, admin deposit release/forfeit (auto-refund via Zelle manual path), PayPal LIVE Orders v2 config + create/capture flow, site-config logo swap, Saturday blackout, 48h cancellation policy, and Twilio+SMTP live notifications no-throw. All 26 pytest tests pass (26/26).

minor.issue: Field is exposed as `phone` (not `phone_number` as the review request wording implies). Frontend must read `phone`. Not a bug — just a naming inconsistency between review copy and code.

Trial account rejects unverified BS numbers (HTTP 400 error 21211). Correctly caught and logged as WARNING; API returns 200 to caller. Expected behavior per review note. Main agent should upgrade Twilio to paid account before go-live to un-limit numbers.

action_items: None — all critical flows pass. Consider upgrading Twilio from trial to a paid subaccount before go-live so SMS lands on unverified customer numbers.
Consider renaming site-config `phone` -> `phone_number` for consistency with review copy, or update copy to say `phone`.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1625 lines — should be split into modules (auth, bookings, admin, payments, deposits, notifications, pdf, chat).

`_attempt_deposit_refund` returns provider=booking.get('payment_method','manual') on the manual fallback — good; message contains 'Manual payment method — issue refund by hand' which drives the Zelle test.
PayPal secret is correctly withheld from /api/paypal/config (verified via key scan).
`_validate_open_day` iterates from booking_date for `days` days — a 3-day rental starting Friday will trip the Saturday check. Documented behavior; ensure UI messaging matches.
cancel endpoint uses simple minute math on `booking_date` — if `booking_date` lacks timezone we assume UTC; matches _parse_booking_date normalization.
test_credentials: admin@roxtaxi.com / admin123 verified via POST /api/auth/login (returns JWT with 3 segments; wrong-password returns 401).
seed_data_creation: ~15 TEST_ prefixed bookings created across the run (TEST_Deposit_1d/3d/pp/notify, TEST_TaxiNoDep_p1/p4, TEST_Deposit_auth/invalid/zrelease/forfeit/no-auto/paid/no-dep, TEST_TaxiNoDep_cancel_soon, TEST_Deposit_cancel_far). Six of them were force-marked payment_status='paid' via mongosh to exercise deposit refund + cancellation paths. All are prefixed TEST_ for cleanup.
